module.description: A search form in a native dialog where every command is a link. The combobox roles are applied by the controller that implements them, never rendered as an unfulfilled promise.
module.name: command

ui.name: command-group
ui.summary: Renders a titled group of commands.

ui.guidance: A link, because every command has a destination. Rendering it as a div with a click handler would make it unreachable by keyboard, un-middle-clickable, and invisible to a screen reader's list of links.
ui.name: command-item
ui.summary: Renders one command as a link.

ui.guidance: The markup is a real form pointing at a real search page, inside a native dialog. With no JavaScript the palette is a search form that works; with it, the input becomes a combobox over a listbox and Cmd/Ctrl-K opens the dialog. The combobox roles are added by the controller, not baked into the markup, because an input claiming role="combobox" with no active descendant and no key handling is worse than a plain text field.
ui.keyboard: Cmd/Ctrl-K opens the palette, ArrowUp/ArrowDown move the active option, Home/End jump to the ends, and Enter follows the highlighted command or submits the search when nothing is highlighted.
ui.name: command-palette

module.title: Command palette
